title: Security & Privacy - fresh merge diagnostic recovery
description: Fresh recovery chapter for Threat Control merge with phase-level evidence and no stale runner state reuse.
script: $ErrorActionPreference='Stop';$p='C:/3EN-Agent/merge-security-monitor-into-privacy-gui-v1.ps1';Write-Host 'MERGE007_PHASE=DOWNLOAD';Invoke-WebRequest -UseBasicParsing -Uri ('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/3en4all/3en-command-runner/main/scripts/merge-security-monitor-into-privacy-gui-v1.ps1?ts='+[DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow.ToUnixTimeMilliseconds()) -OutFile $p -TimeoutSec 30;Write-Host 'MERGE007_PHASE=PRECHECK';try{$b=Invoke-RestMethod -Uri 'http://127.0.0.1:8766/api/status' -TimeoutSec 12;Write-Host ('BRIDGE_PRECHECK=PASS;ROUTER_SSH='+$b.routerSsh+';ITEMS='+@($b.items).Count+';SOURCE='+$b.source);if(-not $b.routerSsh){throw 'bridge router SSH false'};if(@($b.items).Count -lt 1){throw 'bridge items empty'}}catch{Write-Host ('BRIDGE_PRECHECK=FAIL;TYPE='+$_.Exception.GetType().FullName+';ERROR='+$_.Exception.Message);throw};Write-Host 'MERGE007_PHASE=APPLY';try{& $p -Phase Apply;Write-Host 'MERGE007_APPLY=PASS'}catch{Write-Host ('MERGE007_APPLY=FAIL;TYPE='+$_.Exception.GetType().FullName+';ERROR='+$_.Exception.Message);if($_.ScriptStackTrace){Write-Host ('STACK='+($_.ScriptStackTrace -replace '[\r\n]+',' | '))};throw}
